newsitem.title: USA: Florida Panthers files 6 mln common shelf.
newsitem.headline: Florida Panthers files 6 mln common shelf.

text.p: Florida Panthers Holdings Inc Tuesday filed a shelf registration with the Securities and Exchange Commission to sell up to six million Class A common shares.
After the offering, outstanding shares including Class A and Class B will total 23,648,444 common, the filing said.
The net proceeds will be used for general working capital.
The Florida Panthers, based in Fort Lauderdale, operates through two business segments: sports and entertainment and leisure and recreation.
The sports and entertainment segment includes the ownership and operation of the Florida Panthers, a professional hockey team.
